zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.owned: 这只已有主人或尚未售出。请先向店主购买。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.busy: 正在接待另一位客人，请稍等。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.unavailable: 现在办不了：可能不在营业时间、绿宝石或背包空位不够，或今日交易次数已满。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.status: 本日交易余量 %s · 照顾用粮 %s
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.guide.resident: 用普通油粮补给照顾用品。有走失委托时先领取线索，再用运输篮带回指定个体；同种替代不会结算。夜间休息，白天办理交易。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.guide.factory: 亲代按组轮转，子油经接收、育成、分选、清洁后出货；周转托盘实际搬运，工人到场作业。可切换油虐用／饲料用及选购库存。原料耗尽、库存满、设备缺失或道路堵塞会暂停。交入后备亲代可补充退役工位，损坏托盘用四个铁锭修复。纸张／馒头／活体袋分别为 1／2／4 绿宝石。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.0: 白天购买用品，需足够绿宝石及一个背包空位。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.1: 白天购买用品，需足够绿宝石及一个背包空位。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.2: 白天购买用品，需足够绿宝石及一个背包空位。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.3: 白天购买用品，需足够绿宝石及一个背包空位。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.8: 手持你自己的装有个体的运输篮。该个体将用于加工，不可当作寄养。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.11: 消耗 8 份普通油粮，补充 NPC 的有限照顾用品。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.12: 了解店铺、工厂或照顾委托的实际规则。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.production: 成品库存 %s；生产原料 %s。每次购买队首成品一份。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.ingredient.1: 手持至少 8 根甘蔗，补充劳力工场原料。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.ingredient.2: 手持至少 8 份小麦，补充馒头面皮原料。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.ingredient.3: 手持至少 8 张纸，补充包装材料。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.bag_description: 单体活体包装，右键地面拆袋。饲料规格已标示，捕食种投喂待其接入。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.14: 购买生产库存中的实际成品。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.worker_away: 工人不在附近，请到生产线旁找工人办理。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.17: 选择后续分选的商品用途；两种用途交替生产。已经分选的批次保留原用途。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.18: 选择要购买的用途，只从匹配的真实库存出货。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.19: 手持装有成年普通种的运输篮。工厂接收后备亲代，检查亲缘与配对后补入空工位。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.20: 托盘损坏后，手持至少 4 个铁锭修复。未加载的托盘不会被复制。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.pipeline_state: 产线：%s；亲代 %s，育成 %s，待出货 %s；出生检查 %s，观察转入 %s。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.package_treatment: 已检视、清洁。年龄、亲缘和身体状态随原个体保留。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.grain: 这些油粮我收下了，喂它们用。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.friendly.0: 今天天气不错，看看有没有饿着肚子的野生油库里。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.friendly.1: 野生的也要好好对待，慢慢喂，别吓着它们。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.friendly.2: 买油库里请去宠物店，店里有专门的店员。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.pet.0: 我的孩子在家等着呢，早上我会带它出来散步。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.pet.1: 牵绳不要拉得太紧，它走累了就让它歇一歇。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.pet.2: 散步对它很好，回来就不闹了。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.walk.0: 别急，我们在散步，让它自己走。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.talk.walk.2: 绳子牵着，它就不会跑丢了。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.core.sold_factory: 工人高价收下了中枢馅，付你 %s 绿宝石。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.core.sold_shop: 店主收下了中枢馅，付你 %s 绿宝石。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.guide.shopkeeper: 店内售卖无章、银章和金章个体，用品按类别分页。初始受训库存有各自的五属性与已学技能；徽章不提高属性，也不保证识别失饰者。购买保留同一只个体、技能与徽章。稀有种展示位不售货。
zh_cn.human.mcyukkuri.help.16: 带上你的宠物去考官那里参加考试、查看记录或补发徽章。

en_us.human.mcyukkuri.owned: This yukkuri is owned or has not been sold yet. Please buy it from the shopkeeper.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.unavailable: Not possible right now: it may be outside opening hours, or you may lack emeralds, a free inventory slot or trades for today.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.guide.resident: Donate regular feed for care. Accept a missing companion clue, then return that same individual in a transport basket. Trade during daylight.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.guide.factory: Parent groups rotate. Trays carry individuals through receiving, nursery, grading, cleaning and packing with staff present. Choose product use and matching stock. Missing materials/stations, full storage and blocked routes pause work. Deliver reserve adults for vacant parent stations; repair broken trays with four iron. Paper/manju/live bags cost 1/2/4 emeralds.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.0: Daylight supply trade; requires emeralds and a free inventory slot.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.1: Daylight supply trade; requires emeralds and a free inventory slot.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.2: Daylight supply trade; requires emeralds and a free inventory slot.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.3: Daylight supply trade; requires emeralds and a free inventory slot.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.8: Hold your filled transport basket. Its occupant will be processed.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.11: Consume 8 regular feed to replenish this NPC’s care food.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.production: Products %s; material %s. Buys the first queued product.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.bag_description: Single live occupant. Use on ground to open. Feed grading is labeled; predator feeding awaits predator integration.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.15: Hold matching materials to replenish this factory.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.worker_away: No worker nearby. Talk to the worker beside the production line.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.17: Choose future grading use. Both alternates between uses; already graded occupants keep their labels.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.18: Choose which real product stock to purchase.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.19: Hold your transport basket with an adult ordinary species. Compatible unrelated reserve pairs fill vacant parent stations.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.20: Hold 4 iron ingots to repair a destroyed tray. Unloaded trays are never duplicated.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.pipeline_state: Line: %s; parents %s, nursery %s, inputs %s; birth checks %s, observation transfers %s.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.package_treatment: Inspected and cleaned. Original age, family and body state are retained.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.grain: I will take this grain for feeding them.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.friendly.0: Nice weather. I am looking for hungry wild yukkuri to feed.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.friendly.1: Treat wild ones kindly. Feed them slowly and do not scare them.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.friendly.2: If you want a yukkuri, go to the pet shop. The staff there handle sales.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.pet.0: My little one is waiting at home. I take it for a walk in the morning.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.pet.1: Do not pull the lead too tight. Let it rest when it is tired.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.pet.2: Walks are good for it. It is calmer afterwards.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.walk.0: No hurry, we are out for a walk. Let it set the pace.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.walk.1: It is having a good time today.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.walk.2: On the lead, it will not wander off.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.talk.cruel.0: ... (He glances at you and says nothing.)
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.core.sold_factory: The worker bought the core filling at a high price: %s emeralds.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.core.sold_shop: The shopkeeper bought the core filling: %s emeralds.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.guide.shopkeeper: The shop sells unbadged, silver and gold individuals, with supplies grouped by category. Initial trained stock has its own five traits and learned skills. Badges neither raise traits nor guarantee hatless recognition. Purchases preserve the individual, skills and badge. Rare-species displays are not for sale.
en_us.human.mcyukkuri.help.16: Bring your pet to the Examiner for exams, records or a badge reissue.
